The '''Assimilated Ender Dragon''' is the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Variant]] of the Ender Dragon. The Assimilated Ender Dragon does not currently have an [[Assimara Parasites|Assimara form]], nor a [[Feral Parasites|Feral Form]], much like [[Assimilated Squid|Assimilated Squids]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider|Assimilated Big Spiders]].

She is one of the [[Bosses]] of the Mod. 

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns naturally in every dimension from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 9|Phase 9]] onwards with a spawnweight of 1, once the End has reached [[Evolution Phases#Phase 3|Phase 3]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
The Assimilated Ender Dragon is both a Melee and Ranged Combatant.

*She is capable of switching between both a flying and grounded state, while grounded she can run at the target at a fast speed or use her ranged attack from a distance, while flying she hovers at a great distance from the target and moves much slower.
*Her Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*Her Ranged Attack is performed by shooting a Projectile, which leaves a Dragon Breath Cloud. The Cloud inflicts the Poison and the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effects, while the Projectile inflicts the [[Viral]] Effect.
**Projectiles fire at a much faster rate while grounded.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Ender Dragon will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
*She can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 60 tick cooldown and 4 Blocks range.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Ender Dragons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Assimilated Ender Dragons are able to be decapitated, her head has a separate hitbox that upon taking enough damage, will fall off as a [[Walking Ender Dragon Head]], and the main body will no longer be able to shoot projectiles.
* The Assimilated Ender Dragon's wings are able to be cut off. Each wing has a separate hitbox that will fall off upon taking enough damage, similar to a [[Adaptation System#Neutralization|Tendril]]. Cutting off one of these wings prevents the Assimilated Ender Dragon from flying.
